# ClerkBench v1: deviations from the pre-registration

One row per gate of the pre-registration plan's decision-gate table (`docs/preregistration/2026-08-13-clerkbench-v1-preregistration-plan.md`, §8, G1–G9), per relevant ruling of the 2026-07-27 uncertainty review, and per other plan item. *Met, revised* means delivered in a changed form, as stated; *unmet* means not done, with what stands in its place. Four of the nine gates are met, three of them in revised form, and five are unmet; three of the unmet carry the plan's own fallback: no rationing claim (G5), no frontier-replication claim (G3), no divergence-depth result (G4). The paper's reproducibility paragraph names every unmet gate and points here. Every plan document cited below ships in `docs/preregistration/`, byte-identical to its dated commit.

| Plan item | Status | What was done instead |
|---|---|---|
| G1 — primary endpoint defined | met, revised | ExcessHorizon = CH6 − CH6_null is published per configuration with paired bootstrap intervals (the paper's null-excess table); per-cell Δ_iid(L) ships in `aggregates/ch6_null_excess.csv`. The i.i.d. leg only — the β0 leg is the separate row below. |
| G2 — seed floor met | met, revised | The first top-ups (2026-08) sat at each configuration's pass@1 bracket, leaving most CH6 brackets three-seeded; top-ups on 2026-09-25 and 26 (UTC) then six-seeded every in-range CH6 bracket, so all 15 carry six seeds at both rungs (the paper's seed-depth table). The floor was met after the board was first computed, not before. |
| G3 — frontier trap question answered | unmet | The 960-call n=20 frontier subset was not run. The n=20 evidence is the v0 nano calibration bank (the paper's pass^k-decay section and trap-anatomy appendix), and no claim is made either way about replication at the frontier. |
| G4 — per-event instrumentation live | unmet | No `event_trace.tsv` output contract and no first-divergent-event grader field were built; the scorer records the first mismatched byte, not an event index. The paper reports no divergence-depth result. |
| G5 — rationing decision rule applied | unmet | Neither leg was run — leg (a) needs G4. Anticipatory rationing appears in the paper only as a named candidate mechanism deferred to future work, not as a finding and not in the abstract. |
| G6 — equivalence tested | met | All twelve adjacent ranked pairs carry a Separated/Equivalent/Indeterminate label under the pre-registered margin δ: nine Indeterminate, one Separated, two Equivalent. |
| G7 — grading transparency | unmet | Strict and normalized CH6 are not published as two board columns. The tolerance moves two rows, DeepSeek V4 Flash (≤77 normalized, ≤50 strict; 9/450 strict-correct against 277/450) and GPT-5.5 (147 against 138); both strict values are in the paper's methodology-choices table and `aggregates/wrapper_slip_counterfactual.csv`. No v1 adjudication pass ran, so there is no raw/adjudicated pair. |
| G8 — availability two-axis | unmet | Only the completion-conditional axis is published; the intention-to-treat axis is deferred to a future release. The assessability rule, and what a finish-reason rule would change, are in the paper's methodology-choices table. |
| G9 — budget approved | met, revised | Approved on 2026-08-15 as Plan B-new at a ≈$175 ceiling rather than the plan's $830–1,190 (execution plan of 2026-08-13). The narrowed scope is what the G2 and G3 rows record. |
| R7 — pre-registered crossing estimator | met | The board and the capability horizon use the monotone (isotonic) fit pre-registered in the 2026-07-27 adjudication; the first-bracket convention an earlier draft used is reported as a sensitivity (the paper's crossing-sensitivity appendix). |
| R14 — matched-context sentinel arm | unmet | No sentinel arm was run on the v1 roster. The matched-context evidence is the v0 three-model emission control, of which only GPT-5.5 is on the v1 board; the other twelve ranked configurations were not run. |
